title: Readings go in the work order's Mileage field; the card updates at once
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance and add to 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM' a service 'PM-M' with a Distance trigger set At 350,000 mileage and canned lines. Save.
  3. Enroll unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 403', whose last recorded mileage is 342,417, on that schedule. Note on its Maintenance tab the Mileage card's rate and confidence (for example 640 a week, High confidence).
  4. Enroll unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 404', which has never had a mileage recorded, on the same schedule.
  5. Create a work order for each unit (New Work Order on the customer page).
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order for 404 and expand the Maintenance schedule card. Read the PM-M row. Look for any reading button or reading window on the card.
  2. Open the work order for 403, expand the card and read the PM-M row.
  3. In the asset card's Mileage field type 350,100 and save it.
  4. Without reloading, read the Maintenance schedule card again.
  5. Open the asset's Maintenance tab and read the Mileage card's rate and confidence.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card has no reading button and opens no reading window of its own; readings are typed in the work order's Mileage and Engine Hours fields above it.
  • On 404 the PM-M row reads Needs mileage reading and points to the Mileage field (in the design: Needs mileage reading · enter it in Mileage above).
  • On 403, as soon as 350,100 is saved the card updates and shows that PM-M has just become due (the spec gives no wording for this notice: record the words you see).
  • The In the shop value 350,100 is enough to make PM-M due at once.
  • The rate and the confidence on the asset's Mileage card do not change until the work order is invoiced.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S16; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-N1: “The panel carries no Enter a reading control of its own. Readings live above it, and an empty reading shows as needing one”
  • S16-R12: “Readings on a work order are entered in its existing Mileage and Engine Hours fields. Where one is missing, the service row reads Needs mileage reading, or Needs engine hours reading, and points to that field. The card opens no reading dialog of its own; once a reading is saved the panel shows what it moved, per S16-E1”
  • S16-E1: “A reading entered here re-evaluates the unit immediately, and a service that has just become due says so. An In the shop value counts toward whether a meter threshold has been reached, so the service reads due at once. It changes neither the rate nor the confidence until it is recorded, per S10-R11”
